summary: Traffic analysis exercise from a Windows host in the NATUREFORCE Active Directory domain (natureforce.com) that received a Windows EXE over unusual TCP port 9000 from 107.175.82.242 and generated CNCmachineRMS RAT C2 traffic to 195.64.128.106:443. The report provides only the pcap context and alert indicators; the infected client's identity and the EXE's SHA-256 are left as analyst questions without stated answers.

host_artifacts.context: AD domain controller host name at 10.10.1.10

network_artifacts.context: Sends Windows EXE to client over unusual TCP port 9000
